extracted_formulas.name: Arbitrage opportunity and stake-distribution calculation (calculateArbitrage)
extracted_formulas.reconstruction: For each American-odds price, the bundle converts positive odds with price/100+1 and negative odds with 100/abs(price)+1. It converts those decimal odds to implied probability (1/decimal odds), sums the implied probabilities, and classifies the set as an arbitrage when the sum is below 1. It allocates a default total stake of 1,000 in proportion to each bet’s implied probability, then computes each bet’s potential profit, total expected profit, ROI, and arbitrage margin.

components.name: Decimal odds for positive American price: price/100 + 1
